title: Concise winmap, manager handoff, and ask — scratchpad
content:
Goal: build a single-page, blunt narrative I can read in 90s before a calibration, skip-level, or 1:1. Focus: outcomes, uncertainties, explicit asks, and 3 quick evidences.

Topline claim (1 line): Over the last 12 months I moved the onboarding funnel from 62% to 82% activation for new hires in Eng infra by introducing a staged buddy program, a ‘first-week checklist’ templated in Notion, and a short kickstart sync; impact showed up in fewer early escalations and faster access approvals.

Why this matters (2 bullets):
- Reliability: fewer blocked tickets for infra access reduced toil on SREs and shortened time-to-first-contribution by ~6 working days.
- Leverage: the template is now used by two other teams and saved ~8 hours of manager time per hire on average.

Concrete metrics (quick):
- Activation rate (first 14 days): 62% -> 82% (cohort compare, n≈48)
- Mean time to first meaningful PR: 14d -> 8d (team-sampled)
- Tickets escalated to SRE in first week: 16 -> 6 (monthly average)

Three short evidences (one-liners I can recite):
1) Quote from infra lead: “The onboarding checklist cut our account-request churn in half — huge win.” (Slack thread 2025-08-12)
2) Notion audit: onboarding template adoption spike after rollout (internal analytics, 2025-09 snapshot).
3) Manager note (EM): “New hires ship features faster and need less intervention — freed hours for strategy.”

Risks / doubt cases (say this unprompted):
- Sampling bias: initial cohorts were skewed toward more experienced ICs; ongoing tracking needed to confirm uplift across junior hires.
- Attribution: some latency improvement overlaps with tooling upgrades (SAML SSO changes); I’ve isolated periods to estimate partial attribution but call it conservative.

Requests / asks (clear, prioritized):
1) Ask for calibration: label this as a +promotion signal and include in my calibration packet (I want it flagged as a growth outcome).
2) Resourcing: short-term approval for 0.1 FTE support (contract) to scale buddy coordination for next two hiring surges.
3) Coaching: 1 skip-level readout with VP of Eng to align on cross-team rollout before EOY.

Manager handoff bullets (what I want them to say if asked):
- TL;DR: led a cross-team operational improvement that materially improved ramp and reduced infra escalations.
- Evidence: metric deltas above + two manager quotes in attached Slack thread.
- Ask: endorse the promotion signal and approve a small coordination budget.

Prep for hard questions (scripts / one-liners):
Q: How do you know it’s not just the SSO change?
A: I controlled for timing by comparing same-week cohorts across teams; the checklist cohorts show effect independent of SSO rollout windows.

Q: What happens if buddy coordination fails at scale?
A: Built fallback: lightweight automated nudges and a shared backlog to catch mismatches; coordination contract funds cover 2-month trial and a handoff playbook.

Unresolved TODOs (short):
- Attach cleaned cohort comparison CSV (JIRA-PEOPLE-342 data) — need to export and anonymize.
- Ask Arpita for one-sentence manager quote to include in packet.
- Draft short one-page for VP readout (due 2026-03-18).

Small tactical reminders (personal):
- Keep the one-line claim consistent across channels.
- If asked about headcount, default to: ‘this is scaling support, not hiring new FTEs.’
- Practice the 90s script twice before calibration.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Consider adding a tiny ab test for buddy assignment (random vs manager-picked) next quarter — low lift, high signal.
- Keep tracking activation by seniority band; current n for junior hires still low.

Quick copy for Slack DM to manager: 
"Heads-up: I’m adding the onboarding win to my calibration packet — three metrics + two manager quotes. Would you mind reviewing the short one-pager tomorrow morning? I’ll ping Arpita to add her quote."

References / where to pull attachments:
- JIRA-PEOPLE-342 (cohort data)
- CONFLUENCE-6218 (playbook + checklist)
- Slack thread: #infra-onboarding (2025-08-12 message id in linked_artifacts)

End — keep this page terse. Read 90s, hand off, log ask, follow up on TODOs.
